identificationModule.briefTitle: Relatrilfa-α Plus Single-Agent Chemotherapy as Neoadjuvant Therapy for Resectable Stage II-III NSCLC (Phase 2)
identificationModule.officialTitle: Efficacy and Safety of Rilapentib Alpha Combined With Monotherapy Chemotherapy for the Perioperative Treatment of Resectable Stage II-III Driver Gene-Negative Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer (NSCLC): A Single-Center Phase II Study

leadSponsor.name: Tianjin Medical University Cancer Institute and Hospital

descriptionModule.briefSummary: This is a single-center, single-arm, phase 2 trial evaluating the efficacy and safety of retlirafusp alfa combined with single-agent chemotherapy as neoadjuvant treatment for patients with resectable stage II-III EGFR/ALK wild-type non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC).Eligible patients receive 4 cycles of neoadjuvant therapy, followed by curative surgery and 1-year maintenance therapy with retlirafusp alfa.Primary endpoints are pathological complete response (pCR) rate and safety. Secondary endpoints include major pathological response (MPR), event-free survival (EFS), and overall survival (OS).

interventions.name: Drug: Retlirafusp alfa
interventions.description: 30mg/kg intravenously every 3 weeks (Q3W) for neoadjuvant and maintenance therapy

interventions.name: Drug: Single-agent Chemotherapy
interventions.description: Nab-paclitaxel or pemetrexed (per histology), intravenously Q3W

interventions.name: Procedure: Radical Surgery
interventions.description: Radical resection of lung cancer after neoadjuvant therapy

primaryOutcomes.timeFrame: Assessed at the time of surgery, approximately 6-8 weeks after completion of neoadjuvant therapy.

secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: Assessed at the time of surgery.
Assessed from randomization up to 36 months post-surgery.

secondaryOutcomes.description: The time from randomization to death from any cause.
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: From the start of randomization until the study end date (expected January 30, 2028)
Assessed at the time of surgery.

secondaryOutcomes.description: The percentage of patients with no residual tumor at the surgical margin.

Patients completed the EORTC QLQ-C30 questionnaire to assess changes from baseline in scores across the functional domains (physical, role, emotional, cognitive, and social) and the symptom domain. The total score on the questionnaire is 100; higher scores in the functional domains indicate better quality of life, while higher scores in the symptom domain indicate more severe symptoms.
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: Baseline; before each cycle of neoadjuvant therapy; at the time of surgery; 3, 6, and 12 months post-surgery
Assessed from surgery up to 5 years post-surgery.

secondaryOutcomes.description: The total number of lymph nodes that tested positive on pathological examination in the surgical specimen.
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: Assessment will be conducted after the surgery, once the pathology report is available.

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Incidence of severe postoperative complications (Clavien-Dindo classification ≥ Grade III)
secondaryOutcomes.description: The proportion of patients who experienced severe complications classified as Clavien-Dindo grade ≥III within 30 days postoperatively.
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: Continuous monitoring from the time of surgery through 30 days postoperatively.

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Incidence and severity of adverse events (CTCAE v6.0)
secondaryOutcomes.description: In accordance with the CTCAE v6.0 criteria, assess the incidence and severity grading of all adverse events occurring during treatment.
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: The period is calculated from the first administration of the study drug until 30 days after the last dose; for delayed adverse reactions, the period is calculated until 1 year after the last dose.

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Percentage of patients whose dosage was adjusted due to adverse events
secondaryOutcomes.description: The proportion of patients who required dose reduction or treatment interruption due to adverse events out of the total number of enrolled patients.
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: Calculated from the start of the first treatment with the study drug until 30 days after the last dose.

secondaryOutcomes.description: Patients completed the EORTC QLQ-LC13 questionnaire to assess changes in scores for lung cancer-related symptoms (such as cough, shortness of breath, and pain) compared to baseline. The scale is scored out of 100, with higher scores indicating more severe symptoms.
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: Baseline; before each cycle of neoadjuvant therapy; at the time of surgery; 3, 6, and 12 months post-surgery.
